title: 第13章 留客伏计
content_zh:
傍晚，大雨止了，三警员道了搅扰别过，温文新送出门外。

    那破衣乞丐携了男孩的手也准备告辞，温老太向那男孩瞧了一眼，想起他怒斥方玲时正气凛然的神情，心想：“这小小孩童，居然有此胆识，倒也少见。”问道：“两位要上何处？路费可够用了？”乞丐说：“我们兄弟二人流落江湖，四海为家，说不上往哪里去。”温老太向那孩童细**量，沉吟：“两位若不嫌弃，就在这儿帮忙干些活。咱们堡大，也不争多两口人吃饭。”那乞丐心中另有打算，一听大喜，当即上前拜谢。温老太问起姓名，乞丐自称叫王辉，那男孩是他弟弟，叫作王庚。

    当晚王辉和王庚兄弟俩由管家分派，住在西偏院旁的一间小屋中。二人关上门窗，王辉丑陋的脸上满是喜色，低声说：“少侠，你过世的爸妈保佑，这两张秘籍终于回到你手上。真是老天爷有眼。”王庚说：“大哥，你千万别再叫我‘少侠’，一个不慎给人听见了，平白惹人疑心。”王辉连声称是，从怀中掏出那油纸小包，双手恭恭敬敬递给王庚。他倒不是对这男孩尊重恭敬，却是想起了遗下两页秘籍的那位恩人。

    王庚问：“大哥，你跟那个曹虎说了几句什么话，他就心甘情愿交还了秘籍？”王辉说：“我说：‘你撕去的两页秘籍呢？秦大侠叫你还出来！’就这么两句话。那时秦大侠便在他眼前，这是千载难逢的良机，他就有天大的胆子，也不敢不还。”王庚沉吟一会问：“这两页秘籍为什么在他那里？你为什么叫我记着他的相貌？他为什么见了秦大侠这样害怕？”

    王辉不答，一张脸抽搐得更加难看，泪水在眼眶中滚来滚去，强忍着不让掉下。王庚说：“大哥，我不问啦。你说过等我长大了，学成了武功，再原原本本地说给我听。我这就好好地学。”

    于是兄弟俩在温家堡定居了下来。王辉在菜园中挑粪种菜，王庚在练武厅里扫地抹枪。岳胜在温家堡养伤，闲着就和儿女、温文新三人讲论拳脚。他们在演武练拳的当儿，王庚偶然瞧上一眼，但绝不多看。

    他们知道这男孩很大胆，却从没想到他身有武功，因此当他偶尔看一眼的时候，不论是有数十年江湖经历的岳胜，还是聪明机警的温文新，从来不曾疑心过他是在留意拳法的奥妙。但他绝不是偷学武艺。他心中所转的念头，岳胜他们更加想不到了。因为每当他看了他们所说的奇招妙招后总想：“那有什么了不起？这样的招数，只好用来跟蠢材笨蛋胡混瞎缠，又怎打得倒英雄好汉？”

    因为这男孩其实叫闵嘉庚，是闵恩仇的儿子，就是那位在天竺山大顶峰和秦英豪大战了五天不分胜负的闵刀王。因为他父亲遗给他记载着武林绝学的一本《北斗秘籍》。

    这本秘籍本来少了开篇两页，缺了扎根基的入门功夫，缺了总诀纲领，于是不论他多么聪明用功，总不能入门，练来练去始终不对头。现下机缘巧合，给曹虎偷去的总诀找回来了，本来碰得焦头烂额拼命也走不通的处所，突然变成坦途大道，武功进境一日千里。

    曹虎凭着学自两页纸的寥寥十余怪招，便能称雄武林，连岳胜也败在他手下。闵嘉庚却从头至尾学全了。当然，他年纪还小，功力还浅，许多精微之处还不了解。但凭着这本秘籍，他练一天抵得上温文新、周银兵他们练几年。

    何况，即使他们练上三五十年，也不会学到这天下绝艺。这《北斗秘籍》乃是武学瑰宝，闵家高手都会将自己的武功心得写进其中，剑法、刀法、长武器、短武器、软武器、掌法、拳法、腿法、暗器、轻功等等，实是包罗万有。更有几页乃是记载最上乘的内功秘要——小天星玄玉通真功，此神功阴阳调和，刚柔并济，一旦练成，内力自生速度奇快，似无穷尽。即使是平庸之极的一招，出手时也有莫大威力。

    每天半夜里，他就悄悄溜出堡去，在荒野里练拳练剑练刀。他用一柄木头削成的刀剑来练习，每刺出一剑，就想象着要刺入杀父仇人的胸膛；每砍出一刀，就想象着要砍去杀父仇人的脑袋。虽然，他并不知仇人到底是谁。但辉哥将来会说的，等他长大成人、武艺练好之后。

    于是他练得更加热切，想得更加深刻。秘籍中的难处，一项一项想明白了。因为，最上乘的武功是用脑子来思考的，而不单单是用手脚来练习的。

    这样过了七八个月，岳胜的伤早就痊愈了。温老太知道温宏伟虽一世英雄，但去世时儿子年幼，学不到多少万澜集团的高明武功，她知岳胜拳脚功夫了得，便留他教导温文新功夫。岳胜经恶斗曹虎一役后心灰意懒，只想及早退出江湖，好在半生奔波，略有积蓄，物流公司便暂不营业，眼见主人殷勤，也就住了下来。

    温文新没拜他为师，只因温老太有这么一股傲气，温宏伟家传绝艺，怎能去投外派师父？但岳胜感念他家护货的恩情，对温文新如同弟子一般看待，只要是自己会的，他想学什么就教什么，将拳技的精要倾囊以授。百胜拳的外号殊非幸致，拳术上确有独到造诣，这七八个月中温文新确实获益良多。

    岳胜也已看出来，温家堡并非卧虎藏龙另有高人，只是那日曹虎为何匆匆而去，却百思不得其解。有次他偶然把话题带到这件事上，温老太微微一笑，顾而言他。岳胜知主人不肯吐露，从此绝口不提。

    这日午后，闵嘉庚打扫了大厅和练武厅，溜出堡去，到后山林子里玩耍。他常于无人时在这里练习轻功，追兔逐犬，飞身捕鹊，掷石捉鸦，这时正玩得高兴，忽听温文新的声音说：“岳伯伯，那路通臂六合拳其中我还有好些不明白的，请您指点。”闵嘉庚忙钻入一棵柏树后的长草丛中，只听岳胜说：“好！小兵、青青，这路拳法你们是练熟了的，便拆给少堡主瞧瞧吧。”

    闵嘉庚从草丛中向外望出去，只见岳青脱下外套，紧了紧腰带，笑着说：“哥，请你手下留情。”周银兵嘻嘻一笑说：“好说，好说！干爸，我们拳脚生疏了，请您指点。”岳胜说：“常言说：拳不离手，曲不离口。学过的拳脚怎么可以生疏的？”周银兵应了声：“是！”向岳青一招手，跃入草场中间。

    岳青说：“拳招来啦！”左手轻轻一拳，周银兵举右手一架，岳青右臂倏地击向周银兵面门，拳头离他鼻子约有半尺。周银兵仰后相避。不料岳青的右臂突然似乎长了一尺，本来力道看来已尽，陡然间手臂不动，拳头疾伸，啪的一下，正中周银兵鼻旁脸颊。周银兵哎呦一声，跳开两步。岳青笑着说：“哎呦，对不起！”温文新拍手大笑，叫道：“好，好！通臂连拳果然了不起！”

    周银兵有心让义妹一招，好讨她欢喜，否则决不致连第一招最初步的通臂连拳也让不开，听温文新大声喝彩，见干爸板起了脸不作声，便即转身出拳，呼呼有风。兄妹这一交上了手，周银兵更不相让，毕竟他力大招沉，又多学了半年，岳青渐渐抵挡不住，避让稍迟，左肩上吃了一拳。她哎呀一声呼叫，周银兵微笑说：“对不起。”转头向温文新瞪眼相视，心想：“好小子，你瞧仔细了！”温文新侧头瞧着远处*，假装没瞧见他这招。

    岳胜说：“这通臂连拳嘛，最要紧的是要记得虚实之用。”走上来虚拟拳脚，口中说：“招数的名称当真过招时不用记着，记了也是没用。咱们说‘凤凰旋窝’、‘燕子掠水’什么的，只不过教招时有个名目，我说之后，你们知道我使的是哪招而已，当真动手，你用‘凤凰旋窝’把对手打倒，还是用‘燕子掠水’把对手打倒，半点也不相干。你心里记着招数，反而把虚实之用给忘了。你只要见到他左臂这么一沉，就知他右拳便要打过来。又要瞧他右腰，倘若并不当真使劲，他右拳这下便是虚的，真正实招却在左手，左手拳这下可就结结实实厉害得很了。你闪他的右手拳，往左一避，砰的一下，刚好凑上了他的左拳。通臂连拳双臂忽左忽右，两条手臂似乎串成了一起，倒像左臂可以连接到右臂上，有时右臂又可连接到左臂上。其实两条手臂如何可以互相连通，只是转换得快了，对手头晕眼花，分不出虚实而已。”

    周银兵与岳青对这路通臂连拳早就练得纯熟，岳胜将温文新叫过来，指点了拳招，着重解释虚实之道，连比带说，详细解明。
content_en:
In the evening, the heavy rain stopped. The three police officers said goodbye to the trouble and sent Wen Wenxin out the door.
The beggar in ragged clothes took the boy's hand and was about to leave. Mrs. Wen glanced at the boy and remembered his righteous expression when he angrily scolded Fang Ling. She thought to herself: "It's rare for this little kid to have such courage." She asked, "Where are you two going? Do you have enough travel expenses?" The beggar said: "WeThe two brothers are living in the world, and there is no telling where they will go." Mrs. Wen carefully considered the child and said to herself, "If you don't mind, you can help with some work here.We are a big family and we don't want to fight for two more people to eat."When Mrs. Wen asked about his name, the beggar claimed that his name was Wang Hui, and the boy was his younger brother, named Wang Geng.
That night, brothers Wang Hui and Wang Geng were assigned by the housekeeper to live in a small house next to the west courtyard.The two closed the door and window. Wang Hui's ugly face was full of joy and he whispered: "Young hero, with the blessings of your deceased parents, these two secret books are finally back in your hands. God is really wise." Wang Geng said: "Brother, please don't call me 'young hero' again. If someone accidentally hears it, it will arouse suspicion." Wang Huilian claimed that it was, took out the small oil paper bag from his arms, and handed it to Wang Geng respectfully with both hands.He was not respectful to the boy, but he thought of the benefactor who left the two pages of secrets.
Wang Geng asked: "Brother, how many words did you say to that Cao Hu, so that he willingly handed over the secret book?" Wang Hui said: "I said: 'Where are the two pages of the secret book that you tore off? Qin Daxia asked you to come out!' Those two words. At that time, Daxia Qin was in front of him.This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, and he has the courage to not return it." Wang Geng pondered for a while and asked, "Why do you ask me to remember his appearance?Why is he so scared when he sees Da Xia Qin?"
Wang Hui didn't answer, his face twitched even more ugly, and tears rolled in his eyes, trying not to fall.Wang Geng said: "Brother, I won't ask. You said that when I grow up and learn martial arts, you can tell me the truth. I will learn it carefully."
So the brothers settled down in Wenjiapu.Wang Hui was picking manure and growing vegetables in the vegetable garden, while Wang Geng was sweeping the floor and wiping guns in the martial arts training hall.Yue Sheng was recuperating from his injuries in Wenjiabao. When he was free, he talked about fists and kicks with his children and Wen Wenxin.While they were practicing martial arts, Wang Geng occasionally took a look at them, but never looked at them more.
They knew that the boy was bold, but they never thought that he had martial arts skills. Therefore, when he occasionally glanced at him, whether it was Yue Sheng, who had decades of experience in martial arts, or Wen Wenxin, who was smart and alert, they never suspected that he was paying attention to the secrets of boxing.But he definitely didn't learn martial arts secretly.The thoughts in his mind were even more unexpected by Yue Sheng and the others.Because every time he saw the wonderful tricks they talked about, he always thought: "What's so great about that? Such tricks can only be used to fool around with idiots, how can they defeat heroes?"
Because this boy is actually named Min Jiageng, the son of Min Enchou, the Min Dao King who fought Qin Yinghao at the top of Tianzhu Mountain for five days with no outcome.Because his father left him a "Beidou Secret Book" that records the secrets of martial arts.
This secret book was originally missing the first two pages, lacked the basic introductory skills, and lacked the general outline. Therefore, no matter how smart and diligent he was, he could never get started, and he never got it right after practicing again and again.Now, by chance, the secret that was stolen by Cao Hu was recovered. The place where he had been exhausted and couldn't get through suddenly turned into a smooth road, and his martial arts progressed by leaps and bounds.
Cao Hu was able to dominate the martial arts world with just a dozen or so strange moves he learned from two pages of paper, and even Yue Sheng was defeated by him.Min Jiageng learned it from beginning to end.Of course, he is still young, his skills are still shallow, and he still doesn’t understand many subtleties.But with this secret book, one day of training for him is worth several years of training for Wen Wenxin and Zhou Yinbing.
What's more, even if they practice for thirty to fifty years, they still won't learn this unique skill in the world.This "Beidou Secret Book" is a treasure of martial arts. Masters of the Min family will write down their own martial arts experience in it. It covers everything from sword skills, sword skills, long weapons, short weapons, soft weapons, palm skills, boxing skills, kick skills, hidden weapons, light skills, etc.There are even a few pages that record the secrets of the most superior internal energy - Xiao Tian Xing Xuan Yu Tong Zhen Gong. This magic skill harmonizes yin and yang, and combines hardness and softness. Once practiced, the internal energy can be generated at an extremely fast speed, seemingly endless.Even a mediocre move can still have great power when used.
Every night in the middle of the night, he would sneak out of the castle quietly and practice boxing and sword practice in the wilderness.He practiced with a sword made of wood. Every time he thrust out a sword, he imagined that it would penetrate into the chest of his father's enemy. Every time he struck out, he imagined that he would cut off the head of his father's enemy.Although, he didn't know who the enemy was.But Brother Hui will talk about it in the future, after he grows up and masters martial arts.
So he practiced more fervently and thought more deeply.The difficulties in the secret book were figured out one by one.Because the best martial arts are thought with the brain, not just practiced with the hands and feet.
After seven or eight months of this, Yue Sheng's injury had long since recovered.Mrs. Wen knew that although Wen Hongwei was a hero all his life, his son was young when he died and could not learn much of the Wanlan Group's superb martial arts. She knew that Yue Sheng was good at boxing and kicking, so she left him to teach Wen Wen new martial arts.After Yue Shengjing's fierce battle with Cao Hu, he was discouraged and just wanted to withdraw from the world as soon as possible. Fortunately, he spent a lifetime running around and saved a little, so the logistics company temporarily closed its business. Seeing the owner's hospitality, he settled down.
Wen Wenxin didn't accept him as his teacher because Mrs. Wen was so arrogant. How could Wen Hongwei choose to be a master from abroad when his family's unique skills were inherited?But Yue Sheng was grateful for the kindness of his family's protector, and treated Wen Wenxin like a disciple. As long as he knew it, he would teach him whatever he wanted, and he would teach him the essence of boxing skills.The nickname of Yum Sheng Quan is indeed a lucky one. Wen Wenxin did have unique attainments in boxing skills. Wen Wenxin has indeed benefited a lot from these seven or eight months.
Yue Sheng had also seen that Wenjiabao was not Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon and there was an expert, but he couldn't figure out why Cao Hu left in such a hurry that day.Once he accidentally brought the topic to this matter, Mrs. Wen smiled slightly and ignored him.Yue Sheng knew that his master was unwilling to tell the truth and never mentioned it again.
In the afternoon that day, Min Jiageng cleaned the hall and martial arts training hall, slipped out of the fort, and went to play in the woods behind the mountain.He often practiced Qinggong here when no one was around, chasing rabbits and dogs, flying to catch magpies, and throwing stones to catch crows. At this time, he was having fun when he suddenly heard Wen Wenxin's voice saying: "Uncle Yue, I have quite a few of those Lu Tongji Liuhe Quan."If you don't understand, please give me some advice." Min Jiageng hurriedly got into the long grass behind a cypress tree and heard Yue Sheng say: "Okay!Xiaobing, Qingqing, you are already familiar with this boxing technique, so show it to the young castle master."
Min Jiageng looked out from the grass and saw Yue Qing taking off his coat, tightening his belt, and said with a smile: "Brother, please be merciful." Zhou Yinbing smiled and said: "Easy to say, easy to say! Godfather, we have a fist-fighting relationship.I'm unfamiliar, please give me some advice." Yue Sheng said, "As the saying goes: the fists never leave the hands, and the music never leaves the mouth.How can you become unfamiliar with the fists and kicks you have learned?" Zhou Yinbing responded, "Yes!" He waved to Yue Qing and jumped into the middle of the grass field.
Yue Qing said: "Here comes the punch!" With a light punch from his left hand, Zhou Yinbing raised his right hand. Yue Qing's right arm suddenly hit Zhou Yinbing's face, and his fist was about half a foot away from his nose.Zhou Yinbing leaned back to avoid each other.Unexpectedly, Yue Qing's right arm suddenly seemed to have grown a foot longer. It seemed that its strength had been exhausted. Suddenly the arm didn't move, and his fist quickly stretched out, and with a snap, it hit Zhou Yinbing's cheek right next to his nose.Zhou Yinbing groaned and jumped two steps away.Yue Qing smiled and said: "Oh, I'm sorry!" Wen Wenxin clapped his hands and laughed, shouting: "Okay, okay! The through-arm combo is really amazing!"
Zhou Yinbing deliberately let his adopted sister use a move to please her, otherwise he would not even be able to get out of the way of the first move, the through-arm punch. Hearing Wen Wenxin cheer loudly and seeing his godfather keep a straight face and remain silent, he turned around and punched, whistling in the wind.Now that the brothers and sisters were fighting, Zhou Yinbing refused to give in. After all, he was very powerful and had to learn the heavy attack for half a year. Yue Qing gradually couldn't resist it. He was late to avoid it and received a punch on his left shoulder.She called out, and Zhou Yinbing smiled and said, "I'm sorry." He turned to Wen Wenxin and glared at him, thinking, "Good boy, look carefully!" Wen Wenxin turned his head and looked in the distance*, pretending not to see his move.
Yue Sheng said: "For this through-arm combo, the most important thing is to remember the use of virtual and real." He came up and made fists and kicks, and said: "You don't need to remember the names of the moves when you are actually doing them. It is useless if you remember them. We say 'Phoenix Swirling Nest', 'Swallow Sweeping Water' and so on, but there are only names when teaching the moves.Now, after I say it, you know which move I am using.It doesn’t matter if you use the ‘Phoenix Swirl’ to knock down the opponent or the ‘Swallow Sweeper’.Shen, you know that his right fist is about to hit.Look at his right waist again. If you don't use the force seriously, his right fist will be weak, but the real move is with your left hand.This left hand punch is very strong and powerful.Left fist.The two arms seem to be connected to each other, as if the left arm can be connected to the right arm, and sometimes the right arm can be connected to the left arm.It's just that the switching is too fast, and the opponent is dizzy and can't tell the difference."
Zhou Yinbing and Yue Qing had already become proficient in this through-arm combo. Yue Sheng called Wen Wenxin over and gave instructions on the fist moves, focusing on explaining the principles of virtuality and reality. They explained it in detail.
